company.shortDescription: nefsy is food-focused shopping app offering fashion, groceries & services, promoting sustainability and humanitarian impact.
company.description:
nefsy, eat for a good cause dine-in app, is operating in the F&B industry with a strong focus on charity. Our aim is to make food donations a lifestyle where people can donate daily at no extra cost for them with global copyrighted solution of buy one feed one at no extra cost. 
Choose from a variety of your favorite restaurants, and feed the needy at no extra cost every time you eat. 

Our local partners are the Dubai Government, Emirates Red Crescent, Islamic Affairs & Charity Activities Department, and UAE Food Bank. Since Nov 2019 we inception of our concept we have donated over 80,000+ meals.
